hero.subtitle: An open-source AI agent that turns Steam reviews into a prioritized backlog of issues, feature requests, and player pain points -- backed by evidence quotes. Self-host with Docker Compose.

demo.subtitle: See SentiNext in action with a guided walkthrough of the full analysis pipeline.
demo.card1Desc: Watch the full pipeline in action: search a game, ingest reviews, and see AI classification happen in real time.
demo.card2Desc: Explore the insights dashboard, review explorer, category breakdowns, and evidence quotes.
demo.card3Desc: Ask natural-language questions about analyzed data and get answers with charts and evidence.
demo.card4Desc: Get help setting up SentiNext on your own infrastructure with Docker Compose or manual deployment.
